| Question | Outcome |
|--------|--------|
| Do both genealogies satisfy the exact fifth-spiral recurrence? | **Yes** |
| Do their downstream internal interval structures differ? | **No - they differ by a global one-step transposition** |
| Does the Cainan insertion change a cross-boundary interval? | **Yes - $3/2$ versus $9/8$** |
| Does the expanded genealogy place Cainan II and Perez at successive residual-return landmarks? | **Yes** |
| Does the shorter genealogy preserve a different meaningful half-cycle candidate? | **Yes - Terah at $g=18$** |
| Has an independently fixed musical constraint eliminated either whole genealogy? | **Not yet** |
